mechanism: Reducer gates emit ERR_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND (gates 2a/2b — manifest file not in registry) and ERR_MANIFEST_SKILL_UNAUTHORIZED (gate 3 — skill not in manifest's authorized_skills list). When either clusters (>=2 occurrences), detect_failure_clusters feeds the raw reason_code as failure_type into analyze_capability_gap, which calls failure_to_class.get(code, 'TRANSFORM'). Since neither code is in failure_to_class, both silently default to TRANSFORM — proposing schema-transformation skills instead of reconciliation or validation skills. The manifest errors are governance boundary failures, not format transformation failures.
hypothesis: If ERR_MANIFEST_NOT_FOUND: RECONCILE and ERR_MANIFEST_SKILL_UNAUTHORIZED: VALIDATE are added to failure_to_class, clustered manifest-gate rejections will propose reconciliation skills (fix manifest registry) and validation skills (fix skill authorization policy) instead of wrong TRANSFORM skills.
